review_type: independent visual review and source-code inspection
methods: Viewed actual full composite PNG with view_image
Compared all six native composite panels with the five user attachments previously viewed in this agent

findings.finding: Both actual whole-complex locator and single Q72–betaPhe53/betaGly54 close-up are visible. Labels, two atom distances and affinity context are retained. Relative size gives real molecular content rather than prose cards.
All four peptide curves and all ten positions retained; compact explicit four-state legend now makes every condition readable. P4/P10 guides do not obscure data.
Both absolute RMSF states across all 45 residues in six CDR segments retain full width. Segment boundaries, common numbering and Gly54 highlight readable; no CDR/annotation overlap.
All 23 eligible interface delta-Hchi positions retained in ranked order. Q72 teal highlight agrees with structural HLA/Q72 label, while neutral other bars prevent false state encoding.
All 135 CDR contrast values visible with all 45 reference-position labels and six CDR headings; no cropping. Independent vertical colorbar gives delta-RMSF and A units.
All 90 union-interface entries retained, with ineligible cells visibly gray and Q72 framed. HLA/peptide grouping, all residue IDs and delta-Hchi nats colorbar visible.

layout.readability_comment: 183 mm full-width density is balanced. Full-width c/d/e/f avoids compressing the 45-residue tracks into a half-width panel. Molecular close-up remains large enough to read atom identities and distances.

colors.absolute_state_semantics: Orange open circles MEL5, purple filled squares alpha24beta17; stable across b/c.
colors.additional_state_semantics: G4A steel-blue dashed diamonds and I7A muted-green dotted triangles are distinct from both main states.
colors.signed_semantics: Both heatmaps use blue decrease, off-white zero, rose increase with quantity/unit labels; ineligible gray is separate from zero.
colors.structural_semantics: Purple TCR-beta and teal HLA/Q72 labels agree with structural image; chain colors are explicit.

caption_requirements: Define gray cells as Hchi-ineligible or not same-amino-acid comparisons rather than zero.
State TCR maturation is alpha24beta17-ELA minus MEL5-ELA; peptide G4A and I7A contrasts use alpha24beta17-ELA as their baseline.
State the 2.94 A and 3.12 A local-structure labels identify the selected interatomic distances; these are structural geometry, not dynamic occupancy.
limitations: This review validates composition, retention and rendering. It does not substitute for independent numerical/source-structure verification.
